Public eMudhra server-certificate chains archived from the named we-have-a-problem.com test hosts in the 2026-10-23 Photonic trust review. These are public certificates, with no private keys or credentials. sha256.json binds the original retained bytes. The offline regression requires the patched WebPKI verifier to reject each chain explicitly as CertDistrusted; an expired or unknown-issuer error does not satisfy the assertion. The test makes no network requests.
